rationale: rewrote generate() from the off-manifold gray-patch distribution to the true task structure: 3-row full-width blue wall with 1-3 controlled opening pockets (12-shape bank, 4-separation guaranteed) and 3-6 gray pieces below covering every rule branch; piece roles constructed and mirror-validated per draw: match_direct, match_flip (forced on hard when an asymmetric opening exists), match_taller (opening + non-branching downward tail), branched (T/plus/2x3/P/3x3 bank, preferring non-matching), negatives (neutral bank + rotated-opening near-misses on hard); wall synthesis guarantees emergent openings equal the carved ones (top-row forced blue above opening columns; texture gaps only where they can never become openings); final grid verified through a Python mirror of the rule (>=1 red and >=1 gray or reject); new structural self_check: square band-sized grid, colors {0,1,5}, exactly-3-row wall, >=1 opening, 2-6 pieces below the wall with a blank row, at least one red target and at least one surviving gray negative; accepts all 5 canonical pairs; rejects recolor and wall-erasure mutations; textures: helpful compact/spread (band-clamped size ends, stay in-distribution), degenerate no_wall/no_pieces/solid_wall (well-formed off-manifold probes that self_check rejects); difficulty bands now observably different: easy 10-12/1 opening/3 pieces, medium 11-14/1-2 openings/3-5 pieces, hard 13-16/2-3 openings/4-6 pieces with flip/taller/rotated-negative witnesses; VERSION 2.1.0 -> 3.0.0 (deliberate distribution break; v2 draws were off-manifold and unreplayable); RULE_HASH unchanged at 4786a7fd9b5c (rule itself was already correct); KRF-0001: self_check now accepts the declared degenerate modes as lawful edge cases (no_pieces -> 0 gray pieces, solid_wall -> wall without opening pockets) while keeping structural rejection power (missing wall, non-3-row wall, foreign colors, wall-invading pieces, >6 pieces, and normal-mode draws with no red target or no surviving gray negative all still rejected; mutation probe 18/18); KRF-0001: dropped the no_wall texture — a wall-less grid crashes the rule's (apply min wall-rows), so it is not edge-but-valid and must not be declared; texture=no_wall now falls through to the normal path; KRF-0001: all int axes now draw via ctx.draw_int_diff over the full declared range (difficulty only skews) with size-aware effective caps (wall_top<=size//2-3, n_openings<=(size-1)//4, piece-slot budget), so every single-axis boundary override is accepted on every band instead of raising ValueError; KRF-0001: degenerate modes honor the meaningful mixed axes (n_openings for no_pieces, n_negative for solid_wall) and explicitly ValueError-reject meaningless combinations; match_style override is now honored in the normal path (direct/flip/taller when applicable); VERSION 3.0.0 -> 3.1.0: default draw mechanics changed (draw_int -> draw_int_diff skew + caps), a deliberate distribution change; RULE_HASH unchanged (4786a7fd9b5c); semantic review: overrides are now honored EXACTLY or rejected with ValueError — _resolve_params adapts only free (non-overridden) parameters around exact requests (grid grows for high wall_top, counts re-draw within placement capacity); infeasible override combinations raise (e.g. grid_size=10 + wall_top>=4, grid_size=10 + n_negative=3); semantic review: n_openings is exact — opening shape widths adapt to the grid so the requested count always fits and the emergent opening count is verified against the placed count; semantic review: removed the non-executable constant axes (position_bias, opening_shapes) from AXES; added observe_overrides(grid) reporting realized grid_size/wall_top/n_openings/n_match/n_negative per draw; construction now enforces exact role separation (match witnesses only from non-branched openings, the branched witness never matches, negatives neither match nor branch) and audits realized counts against requested ones before accepting a draw; fixed degenerate exactness: scatter placement blocks 4-adjacency so pieces cannot merge, and overridden counts that cannot be placed raise ValueError instead of silently falling back; VERSION 3.1.0 -> 3.2.0 for these exactness/distribution changes; RULE_HASH unchanged (4786a7fd9b5c)
summary: A blue(1) wall spans 3 rows with gap openings (0-pockets with blue above inside the wall and blue on both sides in their row). Gray(5) pieces below are keys: a piece turns red(2) iff it branches (some cell has 3+ gray 4-neighbors) or its top rows, as tall as some opening, match that opening's shape directly or left-right mirrored. All other cells stay unchanged.
